sectors.name: Hospitals
sectors.summary: Inpatient and emergency care. More spending adds hospital beds.

FRA.source: share: Eurostat gov_10a_exp, S13, 2024 (https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/databrowser/view/gov_10a_exp/default/table). quantity: Eurostat hlth_rs_bds1, hospital beds, 2024 (https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/databrowser/view/hlth_rs_bds1/default/table)

DEU.source: share: Eurostat gov_10a_exp, S13, 2024 (https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/databrowser/view/gov_10a_exp/default/table). quantity: Eurostat hlth_rs_bds1, hospital beds, 2024 (https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/databrowser/view/hlth_rs_bds1/default/table)

POL.source: share: Eurostat gov_10a_exp, S13, 2024 (https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/databrowser/view/gov_10a_exp/default/table). quantity: Eurostat hlth_rs_bds1, hospital beds, 2024 (https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/databrowser/view/hlth_rs_bds1/default/table)
POL.note: Median wait on the list 2024 (OECD Health at a Glance 2025): hip replacement 343 days, cataract 48 days.

GBR.source: share: default (mean of FRA, DEU, POL): PESA 2026 table 5.2 gives UK health only as medical services, research and central services, no COFOG level 2 split (https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/6a5772f59e63154454413701/PESA_2026_CP_Chapter_5_tables.xlsx). quantity: OECD hospital beds, all functions, 2023 (https://sdmx.oecd.org/public/rest/data/OECD.ELS.HD,DSD_HEALTH_REAC_HOSP@DF_BEDS_FUNC,1.1/GBR........)
GBR.note: England only, general and acute beds: 1.76 per 1 000 (NHS England KH03 Q1 2026/27 over the ONS mid-2025 population). Median wait on the list 2024 (OECD): hip replacement 174 days, cataract 74 days, England.

default.source: share: default: the mean of FRA, DEU, POL and GBR. quantity: default: the mean of FRA, DEU, POL and GBR
default.note: Mean of the four sourced nations (share and quantity).
